description: The beamer presentation class: frames, its own theorem blocks; one column only. The host sets every document's body on the page, never in a frame, so three things beamer does only in a frame, or only for the PDF's metadata, are set here. \beamer@cramped is defined empty, as each frame's start defines it: beamer's itemize, enumerate and description call it, and outside a frame they stopped at 'Undefined control sequence' (beamer.A, batch 3b: 722 branches in 220 documents). \beamer@smuggle moves a skip past its markers only in internal vertical mode, where it can: on the main vertical list the skip is already on the page, and a theorem block stopped at 'You can't use \unskip in vertical mode' (1,773 branches in 92 documents). usepdftitle=false keeps \title out of hyperref's PDF title, which beamer otherwise sets from \inserttitle at \begin{document}: General's title ends its \parbox with \par, which no PDF string takes ('Paragraph ended before \HyPsd@@ProtectSpacesFi was complete': 19 of 19 documents holding it stopped), and a marked title's \ul stopped there too (24 documents). It also drops the PDF's author, which nothing judges. Past \begin{document}, General's title box was \linewidth wide inside beamer's title template, which insets it by 8pt on each side (sep=8pt, added to \leftskip and \rightskip: 16pt over in 18 of 18 beamer.A branches, GitHub run 41584963423); since b22 the host makes it as wide as the line (title.ts, owner item O-T), and the template is unchanged. The abstract (b23, ERRORS ABS-INPLACE): beamer's default abstract templates set it in a beamercolorbox (beamerinnerthemedefault.sty l.324-328), a box, so a breakable box in it stopped at 'Dimension too large' at \pagetotal and a long abstract ran past the page (GitHub run r2-461ed0e: 380 of 692 not-denied abs.kernel and abs.class-native branches failed, 58 on 'Dimension too large', 130 on a page overflow of their own and 215 on one charged to the whole document, e.g. d5455bb7bf6d83a80bc28 l.822; GitHub probe 41775212344 on that document: 19 to 30 of 60 branches pass, the 'Dimension too large' errors gone, frame overflows remain). At \begin{document} the templates take the same indents and font without the box (the abstract colour has no background in the default theme), so the abstract is set on the page, where the host sets every body.
